stem.text: The density of air on the Earth decreases almost linearly with height from $1.22\,\text{kg m}^{-3}$ at sea level to $0.74\,\text{kg m}^{-3}$ at an altitude of $5000\,\text{m}$.

Atmospheric pressure at the Earth's surface on a particular day is $100\,000\,\text{Pa}$. The value of $g$ between the Earth's surface and an altitude of $5000\,\text{m}$ can be considered to have a constant value of $9.7\,\text{m s}^{-2}$.
What will be the atmospheric pressure at an altitude of $5000\,\text{m}$?
